views.name: verification_badges
views.definition:
SELECT u.id AS user_id,
    u.verified_school_role AS role,
    u.verified_school_id AS school_id
   FROM (braincraze.users u
     JOIN braincraze.schools s ON (((s.id = u.verified_school_id) AND s.active)))
  WHERE ((u.account_status = 'active'::text) AND (u.email_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND u.human_verified AND u.school_verified AND ((NOT u.onboarding_required) OR (u.identity_verification_status = 'verified'::text)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM braincraze.school_verification_requests r
          WHERE ((r.user_id = u.id) AND (r.status = 'approved'::text) AND (r.school_id = u.verified_school_id) AND (r.role = u.verified_school_role) AND (r.approved_at IS NOT NULL)))));
